property_summary: For any caller and any new owner, setOwner succeeds and changes c.owner() to the new owner only when the caller is the current owner; otherwise the call reverts and owner stays unchanged — the mutant inverts the check so non-owners succeed (breaking this for some caller) while owners revert.
change_summary: Replace the require condition with `msg.sender != owner` so only non-owners can call setOwner.
